name: Create My Avatar and Register Profile
description: Parameterised avatar onboarding flow that captures a reference photo, generates a stylised expression set from it (per-run consent required for cloud / host-bridge providers), and registers the photo to the personal profile. The reference photo (<profileRoot>/avatar.png) stays separate from the generated set, which lands in <profileRoot>/avatar/draft (empty capture_output_path / avatar_output_dir = active profile root defaults); adopting it is an explicit step: concierge Settings > Voice > avatar > "Use this avatar".

context.avatar_style: friendly stylised illustration, soft cel shading, clean plain light background, head-and-shoulders portrait, centred, facing the viewer
